profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full time backend Software Engineer, part time Adjunct Professor of Computer Science.  Most of my work experience is in Java and Sql with some C++ and others.  I have earned a Bachelor of Science from SUNY Polytechnic in Electrical Engineering, and a Master of Science from Syracuse University in Computer Science.  My github is PJYankee, the majority of my projects are spring/java backend API projects but there is some Kotlin and a Python in there.  Most of my repositories are public.
